class.name: InputLayout
class.brief_description: Editable action defaults for a local Controls scope.
class.description: Save this resource or build one in code, then supply it to [method Controls.boot]. Runtime controls snapshot the defaults and apply local rebinding separately.

method.name: add_button
method.description: Appends a button with the specified physical keyboard location and optional gamepad button. Pass [constant KEY_NONE] to omit the key. Returns this layout.

method.name: add_mouse_motion
method.description: Appends an action for captured relative mouse motion in unscaled screen pixels. Returns this layout.

method.name: add_move
method.description: Appends a normalized movement vector with physical WASD and left-stick bindings. Negative Y is forward. Stable keyboard slot suffixes are [code]/key_left[/code], [code]/key_right[/code], [code]/key_up[/code], and [code]/key_down[/code]. Returns this layout.

method.name: add_right_stick
method.description: Appends a normalized vector with four right-stick direction slots. Returns this layout.

method.name: create
method.description: Returns an empty, independently editable draft.

method.name: has_action_kind
method.description: Checks that the authored layout contains this action ID with the requested value type.

method.name: resolved_actions
method.description: Returns the inline compatibility actions followed by the actions declared through map assets. Map entries appear as resolved actions with their logical ID, map ID, and authored binding references. Edit the original map asset to change its declarations.

method.name: validate
method.description: Returns [constant OK] when IDs, kinds, thresholds, events, and the optional release action are valid. Duplicate IDs return [constant ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS]. Invalid values return [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER]. An unknown or nonbutton release action returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST].

method.name: with_map
method.description: Appends a standalone map asset and returns this layout. Call [method validate] to check the draft.

members.member: Inline actions retained for earlier layouts and existing code-first helpers. Use [member maps] to compose independently editable action map assets.
An unhandled fresh left click captures a released desktop pointer while the controls are active. The capture click and its release are consumed.
Standalone maps whose actions this layout supplies to a local Controls scope. Map IDs, logical action IDs, and binding slot IDs each have their own unique namespace.
Optional button action that immediately releases a captured pointer. Leave empty to let the game or a visible modal control pointer release.
